assurance.C: Producing source inspected; no model execution by this manuscript task.
assurance.L: Saved historical output/report inspected; not a newly reproduced experiment.
assurance.A: Current handoff documents an earlier source/artifact audit; attributed to that audit.

phm_visual_scalar.executed: Full model.predict path with hooks at layers 21, 24 and 27; each feature map spatial-mean pooled (256 dimensions each).
phm_visual_scalar.input: 640x640 RGB, divided by 255; image-derived target supervision.
phm_visual_scalar.descriptor: 768 visual features; historical head selector also admitted feature_latency_ms, giving 769 actual inputs. This is a known implementation confound, not an intended visual feature.
phm_visual_scalar.task: Provisional candidate-area percentage, not independently verified physical damage.
phm_visual_scalar.protocol: EXP-B training / EXP-A validation / EXP-F assessment; separate from principal sensor LOEO.

phm_sensor.input: Variable-length minute-feature sequences: 9 base variables x 7 summaries plus 9 missingness indicators = 72 channels. Separate HF spectral tutorial also has 72 features, with different provenance.
phm_sensor.patching: Custom channel-shared Transformer; default patch length 16, stride 8, width 32, 2 layers, 4 heads, FF width 64; any-valid-time patch mask and masked pooling.
phm_sensor.target_profile: Sorted ascending order statistics through positive softplus increments. Tooth identity discarded; not positional tooth regression.
phm_sensor.fusion: Context/RMS/condition-indicator source-group encoders. The later four-arm audit has a separate preprocessing-isolation limitation. No image branch at sensor inference.
phm_sensor.normalization: Principal LOEO runner fits each training experiment independently. Do not transfer that assurance to the separate four-arm loop.
phm_sensor.LOEO: Train F / validate B / test A; train F / validate A / test B; train B / validate A / test F. Not fitting on both remaining experiments.

reassemble_visual_core.executed: RTDetrForObjectDetection.from_pretrained(...).model.backbone.model only. CNN feature maps; no hybrid encoder, detection decoder or detections.
reassemble_visual_core.input: 16 deterministic distinct frames over the completed action; bilinear 640x640 RGB; /255; no ImageNet mean/std normalization.
reassemble_visual_core.descriptor: Three spatial means concatenate to 896 dimensions per frame; whole-action frame mean.
reassemble_visual_core.head: 896 -> 128 ReLU/dropout 0.1 -> 1; 114945 trainable parameters; CNN frozen.
reassemble_visual_core.fit: AdamW lr 0.001, decay 0.001, batch 128, weighted BCE, gradient clipping 1; inner candidates 5/10 epochs; outer budgets [5,5,10,10,5].

reassemble_sensor_core.input: 512 normalized action-progress positions x 22 channels: force 3, torque 3, gripper 2, efforts 7, velocities 7. Not 512 Hz.
reassemble_sensor_core.statistical: Mean, population SD, median, min, max, q25, q75, range, RMS, progress slope per channel = 220 features, not 192.
reassemble_sensor_core.statistics_fit: Training standardizer; balanced L2 logistic C in [0.1,1,10] selected by mean inner AP; selected-C group-OOF raw logits calibrate unweighted C1 sigmoid.
reassemble_sensor_core.PatchTST: Scratch HF implementation; context 512, channels 22, patch 32, stride 16, width 32, layers 2, heads 4, FF 64; internal scaling disabled; layer norm; dropout 0.1; do_mask_input False.
reassemble_sensor_core.mask: Training channel standardization and mean fill; past_observed_mask passed but does not implement attention suppression in retained configuration.
reassemble_sensor_core.head: Mean patch pool, concatenate channels, 128 projection and binary output; 109505 trainable parameters.
reassemble_sensor_core.fit: 3/6 epoch inner candidates; selected 6 in every outer fold.

reassemble_fusion_core.F2: sigmoid(b + a_visual*p_visual + a_sensor*p_sensor), fixed C1 L2 logistic, three scalar parameters, unweighted objective, no post-stacker calibrator. Signed coefficients are not convex weights.
reassemble_fusion_core.F3: 128-D visual projection and 220 sensor statistics -> separate 128-D projections -> concat + layer norm -> hidden width 32 or 64 -> output. Weighted BCE; candidate 10/20 epochs; sigmoid calibration.
reassemble_fusion_core.F4: Action one-hot 4 + availability 2 -> gate hidden width 8/16 -> masked softmax over calibrated branch logits.
reassemble_fusion_core.F6: Action 4 + quality 36 + availability 2 -> same gate family.
reassemble_fusion_core.gate_link: p = sigmoid(sum_m softmax(h(u) + availability_mask)_m * logit(p_m)); no final intercept correction or post-gate calibration.
reassemble_fusion_core.gate_fit: Unweighted BCE; 40 epochs, lr 0.003, decay 0.001; seeds 20260927/28/29, average probabilities.
reassemble_fusion_core.quality_limit: 16 constant quality fields and 1562 undefined gripper-MAD outlier rows; training mean imputation. Descriptors may encode process content.
reassemble_fusion_core.fallback: Known visual absence -> exact sensor probability and native threshold; known sensor absence -> visual. Both absent error, no tested abstention.
reassemble_fusion_core.dropout: F6: 0.15 visual absent, 0.15 sensor absent, 0.70 both present; never both absent. Single-branch softmax is structurally fixed.

anchored_adaptation.network: 42 -> 16 -> 2, zero final-layer initialization; frozen proper-training F2 anchor; constant two-adjustment control.
anchored_adaptation.fit: penalties [0.01,0.1,1], AdamW lr .003, decay .001, max100/min10/patience12; mean inner AP of three-seed probabilities.
anchored_adaptation.caveat: Different function class from original convex-logit gates; threshold protocol differs from historical F2.

metrics.AP: average_precision_score; not trapezoidal PR area. Pooled OOF AP differs from mean fold AP.
metrics.population: Core4530 actions,509 failures,148 recordings. Later753 is original outer fold0,77 failures,26 recordings.
metrics.uncertainty: Core2000 paired recording-cluster resamples conditional on saved fits; PHM10000 run-cluster resamples. Not full refit or seed uncertainty.
metrics.human_review: 64 clips,one reviewer;57/59 determinate agreement,2 disagreement,5 indeterminate. No adjudication or relabeling.
